data.narrative:
Thunder Tiger operates in the Defense & Security sector and is currently public-stage. The comparable universe includes 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies, with notable private peers including Anduril Industries, Shield AI, Helsing, Evolv Technology, and Saronic. The company has raised $22M+ as of 2025.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The Defense & Security sector contains 24 same-sector peers overall, but the narrow filtering criteria—matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier—yielded fewer than three datapoints, falling below the minimum threshold required for reliable peer-median analysis. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given Thunder Tiger's specialized subsector positioning and would not reflect the specific dynamics of Defense & Security comparables.

Without sufficient narrow-stage peers to support triangulation, this analysis cannot establish a defensible valuation range using the available data. The public comp set (2 tickers) and identified private peers provide directional reference points but insufficient statistical density for quantitative synthesis. A complete valuation would require either expanded comparable data within Defense & Security, transaction multiples from recent M&A activity in the subsector, or discounted cash flow analysis with disclosed financial metrics from Thunder Tiger itself—none of which are present in the current dataset. Key uncertainties include stage-specific growth expectations, technology differentiation relative to peers, and customer concentration risk.
